title: Unified SFI and Venture Author Post
description: The author-owned metadata contract. Draft values may be empty or null; the writing review and publish commands enforce publication completeness.

source.description: Optional path to the copied author document inside this post folder.

subtitle.description: The entry subtitle shown in the site header and indexes.

excerpt.description: A short, plain-text summary used in indexes and newsletters.

entry.description: The global SFI/Venture sequence number. It is a string so leading zeroes are preserved.

date.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD form; an empty or null value is allowed while drafting.

time.description: Publication time in 24-hour HH:MM form; an empty or null value is allowed while drafting.

trip.description: The Venture trip name. SFI-only posts may use null.

thread.description: Optional slug shared by posts that belong to the same story or trip thread.

slug.description: A unique NNNN-title-YYYYMMDD slug. A manual override may customize the lowercase, hyphenated title words while preserving the matching entry prefix and date suffix.

music.description: Optional music tagline. Review requires a non-empty title and artist whenever this object is present.

blog.description: The entry's specialized home. Venture entries also belong to the SFI umbrella archive.

collections.description: Optional collection slugs such as northeast-115, national-parks, or travels.
